what: When a hand rests on the strip along the right screen edge (default 100px), the drawer panel hidden behind it (default 280px) slides out over .3s easeOutQuart, and the text inside floats up .1s later over .25s. When the hand leaves the strip, the inner text switches off in .1s and the panel slides back in over .3s easeInOutCubic. With peek on, the panel first peeks halfway out (-135px) when attached, then hides 1.3s later over .4s easeInOutQuart. On devices without hover, tap the toggle child to open it.

options.peek: If on, it peeks out halfway at first then hides, default off
options.peekx: Panel’s right position when looking out (px, negative), default -135
options.hold: Time to stay peeking out (s), default 1.3

from.where: shared.js .btn-nav-wrap/.nav-fix (subpage right-edge drawer, peeks out on the first subpage)

note: The original moves the right value with Velocity — same curve and duration, done in GSAP. The band is pinned to the right with position: fixed and the panel is absolute inside the band, so even when the hand leaves the band it stays open while over the panel (the panel is a child of the band).
